messages.subject: Global Mining & Natural Resources Executive | ESG, Government Relations & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Ms. Pitsika,

Your recent N2Growth analysis on mining executive search, particularly the importance of stakeholder complexity, sustainability strategy, geopolitical awareness and social licence to operate, closely reflects the leadership environment in which I currently work. I am therefore introducing my profile for relevant senior international searches across mining, energy and natural resources.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My portfolio spans government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications within a major gold-mining operation. I advise senior management on regulator expectations, institutional relationships, community priorities and reputation-sensitive matters, while coordinating execution across corporate, technical and operational functions.

My background combines more than 12 years across multinational mining, regulated financial services and commercial operations, including six successive appointments at AGM since 2020 into Director-level leadership. I have also supported governance and stakeholder alignment around large-scale renewable energy and carbon-data initiatives in an asset-intensive operating environment.

I am particularly interested in Director, VP, Country and Regional mandates spanning Government Relations, External and Corporate Affairs, ESG and Sustainability, Social Performance, Stakeholder Relations, Strategic Partnerships and Country Leadership. I am internationally mobile and open to expatriate or rotational appointments across the GCC, Africa, Europe, Asia-Pacific and the Americas, subject to employer-supported work authorization where required.

My executive CV is attached for your consideration. I would value being considered for current or future N2Growth mandates where institutional trust, responsible development, regulatory discipline and cross-functional execution are central to leadership success.

Best regards,

Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department
AGM Inc. | Zijin Mining Group
Georgetown, Guyana
